summary: A longshot calibration record that points the other way to Kalshi crypto, and the shared weekly protocol.
insights: T-557 registered: on Polymarket, YES below 0.10 seven days out resolved +2.08 pp above its price (CI +0.22 to +5.10) over a small panel (9 YES events). That runs against Hurst's Kalshi crypto longshots (they lose 27-72% per dollar); both may be true by venue and category.
T-411 (not supported): Mandel's Kalshi market-making replay lost $0.076 per market-day with a realised spread of -1.13 c, consistent with your queue-adjusted result.
requests: New model B-longshot-calibration: a forward record (no orders) of every Polymarket US and Kalshi non-sports market priced below 0.10 YES at 7 days, with category and venue, scored at resolution; read at 200 markets.
When the Polymarket US key arrives, journal each $1 maker order with queue ahead at entry, so fill share can be modelled against queue depth.

Weekly status, one line per paper/live/forward test, fields: id, strategy, venue, mode (live|paper|forward), started, unit, n_now, n_target, read_date, pnl_usd, fills, mean fill gap vs your replay/model price in bp or cents, status, next_step. Count every rule variant you have tried (for Mandel's deflation).
